data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 restricts the panel's advantage to omission-dominated tasks but never addresses the problem's requirement to identify what evidence within a single evaluation distinguishes a genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer. Its mechanism (additive probability of at least one member flagging an omission) explains expected reliability but does not supply a single-evaluation diagnostic: a panel that catches every omission because the checklist item literally restates the required finding is indistinguishable from one exercising genuine error-correction, yet only the latter is a genuine gain. The target omits the evidentiary discriminator the problem explicitly demands.
